# Issue #135: the three registry helpers in ci_tools/common.py as they were
# before 257abfb, each handing the `actor:token` pair (or the cosign username
# and password) to skopeo or cosign as arguments. Not imported; read as Python
# source by tests/test_no_credential_in_argv.py, which must flag all four.


def skopeo_inspect_json(image_ref: str, *, creds: str | None = None) -> dict:
    command = ["skopeo", "inspect"]
    if creds:
        command.extend(["--creds", creds])
    command.append(image_ref)
    return run_json_cmd(command, timeout=REGISTRY_METADATA_TIMEOUT)


def skopeo_copy(source: str, destination: str, *, creds: str | None = None) -> None:
    command = ["skopeo", "copy", "--retry-times", "3"]
    if creds:
        command.extend(["--src-creds", creds, "--dest-creds", creds])
    command.extend([source, destination])
    run_cmd(command, capture_output=False, timeout=REGISTRY_TRANSFER_TIMEOUT)


def cosign_verify(image_ref: str, key_path: str, registry_username, registry_password) -> None:
    command = ["cosign", "verify", "--key", key_path]
    if registry_username and registry_password:
        command.extend(
            [
                "--registry-username",
                registry_username,
                "--registry-password",
                registry_password,
            ]
        )
    command.append(image_ref)
    run_cmd(command, timeout=COSIGN_TIMEOUT)
